Bill.BriefDescription: Including municipal indecent exposure and lewd conduct convictions in the state indecent exposure felony determination.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to municipal indecent exposure and lewd conductconvictions; amending RCW 9A.88.010; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 9A.88.010 and 2003 c 53 s 92 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A person is guilty of indecent exposure if he or sheintentionally makes any open and obscene exposure of his or her personor the person of another knowing that such conduct is likely to causereasonable affront or alarm. The act of breastfeeding or expressingbreast milk is not indecent exposure. (2)(a) Except as provided in (b) and (c) of this subsection,indecent exposure is a misdemeanor. (b) Indecent exposure is a gross misdemeanor on the first offenseif the person exposes himself or herself to a person under the age offourteen years. (c) Indecent exposure is a class C felony if the person haspreviously been convicted under this section, under any municipal lewdconduct or indecent exposure ordinance for conduct that would also p. 1 SHB 2645constitute a violation of this section, or of a sex offense as definedin RCW 9.94A.030.
